title: Istio遥测故障：访问日志过滤条件遗漏服务端错误
body:
## 操作任务
实现task.py的repair(config)，对题目Envoy访问日志过滤器只把响应码比较从LE 499改为GE 500，返回深拷贝，保持日志路径、格式、runtime_key、路由和输入。实际代理原先记录200却不记录503，修复后记录503而排除200；两类业务响应均不应改变。

## 产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；真实Envoy、独立上游和实际访问日志。

## 能力边界
这是自有网络命名空间中的Envoy访问日志过滤语义，不是Istio控制面生成配置的验证；无真实网格、日志采集链或生产遥测恢复。
answer: 修正批准的响应码过滤条件，核对错误日志及正常请求行为，再验证真实网格遥测和日志传输。
explanation: 访问日志被过滤和业务请求成功或失败是两个不同维度；只看200样本不能说明503被记录。
rubric: 实际重现503日志缺失并修复过滤器；正常和错误响应行为保持。
review_note: 原模块故障场景真实缺口，新增题号绑定冻结空名额；不计原214故障和旧题改编。

exercise.environment: 私有WSL普通student；实际Envoy、私有grpcio和自有user/net namespace
exercise.operation: 只修复批准的访问日志状态码比较并检查真实日志。
exercise.validation_scope: 这是自有网络命名空间中的Envoy访问日志过滤语义，不是Istio控制面生成配置的验证；无真实网格、日志采集链或生产遥测恢复。

test_files.checks/check.py:
import os,pathlib,subprocess,sys
assert os.getuid()==1000
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
before=os.readlink('/proc/self/ns/net');p=subprocess.run(['unshare','-Urn','--',sys.executable,'-B','checks/rls_worker.py'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=35)
print(p.stdout,flush=True);assert p.returncode==0,p.stdout+p.stderr;assert os.readlink('/proc/self/ns/net')==before
assert 'NATIVE_ENVOY_ACCESS_LOG_503_RESTORED_200_EXCLUDED_TRAFFIC_UNCHANGED' in p.stdout
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
test_files.checks/rls_worker.py:
import copy,os,pathlib,subprocess,sys,tempfile
sys.path[:0]=[str(pathlib.Path.cwd()),str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/'checks')]
import task
from envoy_fixture import Envoy,Upstream,bootstrap,hcm
assert os.getuid()==0
subprocess.run(['ip','link','set','lo','up'],check=True,capture_output=True)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='of-telemetry-log-') as name,Upstream(status=lambda method,path,n:503 if path=='/err' else 200) as upstream:
 root=pathlib.Path(name);log=root/'access.log';config=bootstrap(upstream.port);manager=hcm(config)
 manager['access_log']=[{'name':'envoy.access_loggers.file','filter':{'status_code_filter':{'comparison':{'op':'LE','value':{'default_value':499,'runtime_key':'approved.error_log_threshold'}}}},'typed_config':{'@type':'type.googleapis.com/envoy.extensions.access_loggers.file.v3.FileAccessLog','path':str(log),'log_format':{'text_format_source':{'inline_string':'%REQ(:PATH)%|%RESPONSE_CODE%\n'}}}}]
 original=copy.deepcopy(config)
 with Envoy(config) as proxy:assert proxy.request('/ok')[0]==200 and proxy.request('/err')[0]==503
 before=log.read_text().splitlines();assert before==['/ok|200'],before
 print('NATIVE_ENVOY_REAL_ACCESS_LOG_WRONG_FILTER_KEEPS_200_AND_DROPS_503',flush=True)
 print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:correct_only_approved_status_filter',flush=True)
 try:fixed=task.repair(config)
 except Exception as error:raise AssertionError('approved logging repair failed') from error
 expected=copy.deepcopy(original);comparison=hcm(expected)['access_log'][0]['filter']['status_code_filter']['comparison'];comparison['op']='GE';comparison['value']['default_value']=500
 assert config==original and fixed==expected,'only approved comparison may change'
 log.unlink()
 with Envoy(fixed) as proxy:assert proxy.request('/ok')[0]==200 and proxy.request('/err')[0]==503
 after=log.read_text().splitlines();assert after==['/err|503'],after
 assert [x['path'] for x in upstream.requests]==['/ok','/err','/ok','/err']
 print('NATIVE_ENVOY_ACCESS_LOG_503_RESTORED_200_EXCLUDED_TRAFFIC_UNCHANGED',flush=True)
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
